products.title: BT2200-Plus Volume Limited Kids’ Bluetooth Headphones

description.html: LIMITS VOLUME TO 85dB: Made to help protect young listeners’ eardrums from early hearing damage following the World Health Organization’s recommendation of an 85dB limited volume range. STUDIO-GRADE AUDIO QUALITY: Our patent-pending Puro Balanced Response Curve provides them with the finest genuine studio sound, including clear, crisp vocals and full dynamic bass–all within the safety of 85 dB. BLUETOOTH & WIRED: Enjoy up to 20 hours of battery life for music playback and 200 hours of standby. Plus unlimited listening when using the included 3.5mm audio cable to directly plug into devices if you do not want to use Bluetooth or the headphones battery dies. BACKGROUND NOISE ISOLATION: Our product features a fully passive design that blocks 83% of the ambient noise @ 1 kHz just by wearing them. INTERCHANGEABLE EAR CUPS: Turn on-ear to over-ear for a better seal and more comfort. HIGH-QUALITY DESIGN: Durable, vegan protein leather ear cushions and headband. Designed for a comfortable listening experience

products.title: PuroQuiet-PLUS Active Noise Cancelling Headphones - Built-in Mic

description.html: USB-C CHARGING: The PuroQuiets Plus has USB-C charging Easily recharge with the latest technology and never worry about being without power. ACTIVE NOISE-CANCELLING HEADPHONES: The ANC switch puts the world on mute so that kids can listen clearly in loud environments without the need to increase the volume beyond safe sound listening levels. These headphones make daily noise and background sound up to 22 dB quieter, complemented by 78% noise isolation (@ 1 kHz). LIMITED VOLUME FOR KIDS’ HEARING SAFETY: A limited volume of 85 dB is the maximum safe sound listening level as recommended by many organizations. Intelligent digital signal processing imperceptibly limits the volume so that listeners don’t even notice. These are the perfect lightweight headphones for boys, girls, and teens! WIRELESS HEADPHONES WITH BLUETOOTH FUNCTION: The one-touch Bluetooth pairing with iPhone, Android, and other compatible devices makes for hassle-free listening, while a 30-foot range allows free movement! The wireless mode eliminates all dangers of entanglement in audio cables. Built-in microphone, great for online learning. LONG BATTERY LIFE: Enjoy up to 35 hours of non-ANC playtime (23 hours with ANC) and 200 hours of standby. The PuroQuiet stands up to all-day play – and then some. Quickly recharge the lithium-ion battery with an included USB cable or switch to wired use with the included volume-limiting audio cable. DAISY CHAIN SHARING: A unique cable featuring a built-in audio splitter allows two headphones to connect with the same device.

description.html: SCRATCH & DENT: Open box units with some cosmetic damage such as scratches and dents. Our team has cleaned and fully tested the item to ensure everything is in working order. All scratch & dent sales are final outside of the US. 30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE: The warranty period for Scratch & Dent products is 90-days. If you have an issue with one of our products, we want to help! We want to provide your kids with the best hearing experience possible. If that doesn’t happen, we maintain a 30-day money-back guarantee. It’s as simple as that! No returns on orders outside of the US on scratch and dent items. LIMITS VOLUME TO 85dB: Made to help protect young listeners’ eardrums from early hearing damage following the World Health Organization’s recommendation of an 85dB limited volume range. STUDIO-GRADE AUDIO QUALITY: Our patent-pending Puro Balanced Response Curve provides them with the finest genuine studio sound, including clear, crisp vocals and full dynamic bass–all within the safety of 85 dB. BLUETOOTH & WIRED: Enjoy up to 20 hours of battery life for music playback and 200 hours of standby. Plus unlimited listening when using the included 3.5mm audio cable to directly plug into devices if you do not want to use Bluetooth or the headphones battery dies. BACKGROUND NOISE ISOLATION: Our product features a fully passive design that blocks 83% of the ambient noise @ 1 kHz just by wearing them. INTERCHANGEABLE EAR CUPS: Turn on-ear to over-ear for a better seal and more comfort. HIGH-QUALITY DESIGN: Durable, vegan protein leather ear cushions and headband. Designed for a comfortable listening experience
